_meta.note: pumps.doseLines: Zone A's calibrated pump rate, 15 mL/min = 0.25 mL/s for N, P and K (farm details form, R-1, section 5: average of three 60 s runs); a zone without its own rates takes these. pumps.zones.Z2.doseLines: Zone B's own pumps, the gateway's relays (rig Zone 2), which run 1 L/min = 16.667 mL/s, 67 times faster (the gateway's MG_Z2_PUMP_ML_PER_MIN, snm-prototype-extension-v1 gateway README). That rate is the gateway's setting, not yet timed at the farm as Zone A's was: at 16.667 mL/s, 1 mL is 0.06 s of pumping, under the rig's shortest dose (0.1 s), so Zone B's smallest dose that runs is 2 mL.

sources.pumps.zones.Z2.doseLines: PLACEHOLDER: the gateway's configured 1 L/min, until each pump is timed as Zone A's were (three 60 s runs into a measuring cylinder).
